properties.name: C0046/26 / HADC
properties.originalText:
OPERATORS INTO HADC AIRPORT ARE ADVISE THAT INCREASED BIRD 
   ACTIVITY EXISTS WITHIN THE AERODROME AND APPROACH AREAS DURING 
   SEASONAL RAINY PERIOD.
   PRESENCE OF INSECTS AFTER RAINFALL ATTRACTS BIRDS FEEDING AND 
   MOVING NEAR THE RUNWAY SURFACE. EXERCISE CAUTION DUE TO INCREASED 
    RISK OF BIRD STRIKE.
  PILOTS ARE ADIVESED TO TAKE PRE-CAUTION DURING APPROACHING, 
 ARRIVING,LANDING,TAXING AND TAKE-OFF OPERATION AT AIRPORT.
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境
